Item: US drug pricing: Inflation Reduction Act negotiation
Label: Fact
What it says: Medicare can negotiate prices once a drug is 7 years (small molecule) or 11 years (biologic) past approval; negotiated prices apply about 2 years later (about 9 and 13 years). Rounds so far: 10 drugs (2026), 15 (2027), 15 incl. Part B (2028).
Effect on biologics demand: Longer protection for biologics favours biologic R&D over pills.
Source: KFF, Key facts about Medicare drug price negotiation
Evidence: "at least 7 years (for small-molecule drugs) or 11 years (for biologics) past its FDA approval or licensure date"

Label: Fact
What it says: Enacted 18 Dec 2025 in the FY2026 NDAA (s.851); restricts US federal contracts with named biotechnology companies of concern.
Effect on biologics demand: CDMO work can move away from listed Chinese firms to other providers.
Evidence: Same source as screen 3 country barriers. OMB list of companies due by Dec 2026.

Label: Fact
What it says: Executive order of 12 May 2025; company deals followed: Pfizer (30 Sep 2025), AstraZeneca (10 Oct 2025), with MFN prices for Medicaid and new launches.
Effect on biologics demand: Price pressure on US launches; deals tied to US manufacturing investment.
Evidence: "guaranteeing MFN prices on all new innovative medicines AstraZeneca brings to market". Mockup labelled this Signal: now Fact.

Label: Fact
What it says: Proclamation of 6 Apr 2026 sets duties on patented drugs and APIs; capped rates for some trade partners and firms with onshoring deals.
Effect on biologics demand: Pushes companies to build US plants (see T7).
Evidence: Same source as screen 3. Check rates against the proclamation text.

Label: Fact
What it says: Healthcare venture investment of $60bn across 2,167 deals in 2025, up from $45.4bn in 2024.
Effect on biologics demand: More funded biotechs means more early-stage process development demand.
Evidence: Covers all healthcare venture, not biopharma only; no regional split. Mockup said recovering 2025-26: confirmed for 2025.

Label: Fact
What it says: $3.45bn venture capital raised in H1 2026, up 25% on H1 2025.
Effect on biologics demand: Funding recovering in the largest US cluster.
Source: MassBio Industry Snapshot 2026, reported by WBUR
